subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw make `sourceActor` the public generic attribution contract for plugin tool context and memory corpus supplements in this stack once the remaining fallback bug is fixed?
rationale: The patch adds public SDK/context fields that third-party plugins can depend on and changes how multi-person channel identity reaches memory consumers; automation can fix the wiring bug but cannot choose the permanent API direction.

options.title: Approve generic contract after repair
options.body: Fix the missed fallback and land the optional, untrusted `sourceActor` contract as the generic attribution seam for channels, tools, and memory supplements.

options.title: Keep attribution channel-only for now
options.body: Land or sponsor only the inbound channel source-actor contract and defer memory supplement exposure until the memory backend design is settled.

options.title: Pause for trust-tagging design
options.body: Hold this stack until the broader memory trust/isolation direction has an approved design.

recommendation.title: Approve generic contract after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the missed fallback and land the optional, untrusted `sourceActor` contract as the generic attribution seam for channels, tools, and memory supplements.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved product/API decision is on the memory corpus supplement contract that Vincent Koc introduced and recently shaped.
